creditAllowance.note: CORRECTED during live verification: the single-seat published Enterprise figure (3900) is wrong for this account — credits are pooled across multiple licenses in the enterprise (a 'shared enterprise pool'), and the real pooled monthly allowance is 15000, stated directly by the user. The naive 'seat type -> monthlyCredits' self-serve this schema originally specified doesn't hold whenever seats are pooled — asking seat type alone isn't enough; the actual pooled figure must be asked (or otherwise obtained) directly. Whether the *remaining balance* could be read programmatically instead of asked each time was tested live with a real github-copilot OAuth token (scope read:user) against the GHE host's GET /users/{username}/settings/billing/ai_credit/usage (and the /usage and /usage/summary variants) — all three returned a clean 404, distinct in character from the /user/orgs call's explicit 403 'need read:org scope' response, suggesting the route isn't implemented on that GHE Data Residency tenant at all rather than a scope problem. No programmatic remaining-balance check is available. Remaining balance is NOT cached in this file since it drains continuously — only the allowance is. SEED VALUE: re-confirm against your own seat and enterprise before trusting it.
